2607.16941.title: Investigation of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) Diagnosis Using Machine Learning Approaches
2607.16941.paper_summary: Polycystic Ovarian Syndrome (PCOS) is a widespread hormone problem for women of childbearing age. Women with PCOS may not ovulate; they might have high levels of androgens and have many small cysts on the ovaries. It can cause missed or irregular menstrual periods, excess hair growth, acne, infertility, and weight gain. Machine Learning (ML) can effectively diagnose this disease at an earlier stage as tons of medical data are available now. Traditional approaches to detect PCOS encompass a combination of clinical evaluation, medical history assessment, physical examination, and laboratory tests. These approaches aim to identify the characteristic symptoms and hormonal imbalances associated with PCOS. Physical examination requires good resources and costs time and money. In recent times, data-driven techniques have substantially advanced disease prediction within the medical field. We aim to utilize ML approaches, incorporating unique feature selection algorithms, to predict PCOS. This paper introduces a data-driven approach to PCOS diagnosis, combining Feature Engineering and ML. Several feature selection approaches have been considered to select sets of features for training the ML model, including CatBoost, Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LGBM), AdaBoost, Random Forest (RF). Results demonstrate that AdaBoost, with ten features selected by RF Feature Importance and Highest Correlation (HC), provides the highest test accuracy.
2607.16941.paper_summary_zh: 多囊卵巢綜合症（PCOS）是育齡女性中普遍存在的荷爾蒙問題。<lb/>患有PCOS的女性可能不會排卵；她們可能有高水平的雄性激素，並且在卵巢上有許多小囊腫。<lb/>這可能導致月經不規則或缺失、多毛、痤瘡、不孕和體重增加。<lb/>隨著大量醫療數據的可用性，機器學習（ML）可以有效地在早期階段診斷此疾病。<lb/>傳統的PCOS檢測方法包括臨床評估、病史評估、身體檢查和實驗室檢測的組合。<lb/>這些方法旨在識別與PCOS相關的特徵症狀和荷爾蒙失衡。<lb/>身體檢查需要良好的資源，並且耗費時間和金錢。<lb/>近年來，數據驅動技術在醫療領域的疾病預測方面取得了顯著進展。<lb/>我們的目標是利用ML方法，結合獨特的特徵選擇算法，來預測PCOS。<lb/>本文介紹了一種數據驅動的PCOS診斷方法，結合了特徵工程和ML。<lb/>考慮了幾種特徵選擇方法，以選擇訓練ML模型的特徵集，包括CatBoost、極端梯度提升（XGBoost）、輕量梯度提升機（LGBM）、AdaBoost和隨機森林（RF）。<lb/>結果顯示，AdaBoost使用RF特徵重要性和最高相關性（HC）選擇的十個特徵，提供了最高的測試準確率。
